verdict.rationale: Missive's first-party MCP server lets external assistants such as Claude or ChatGPT work with your conversations, contacts, calendar and drafts, and the changelog cites asking Claude to summarize your inbox. That is a direct route to asking an assistant about your mail and calendar, but it relies on a third-party AI app. Missive's built-in assistant is only shown answering from Missive's own documentation, not answering cross-inbox questions. missing for 10: evidence that the built-in assistant answers questions across the whole inbox and calendar, grounded/cited answers (who said what, what's outstanding), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask an assistant questions across my whole inbox and calendar — who said what, what's outstanding — and get grounded answers

citations.quote: External AI apps like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor can now connect to Missive through the Model Context Protocol and act on your conversations, contacts, calendar, and drafts, with the permissions you choose.
Ask Claude to summarize your inbox and draft replies without leaving the chat
official MCP server documented at https://missiveapp.com/docs/ai/mcp/server
